core_idea: Devyat' Assoc. North Section 3 Rodion is a Damage Dealer / Status Specialist — **Devyat' Courier** who races **Courier Trunk — Rodion** below **15** for faster gains, stacking **Rupture** on targets along the way, spikes clash power and Shield at **15+**, then **Just… a Strategic Time Off!** forces **Strategic R&R** so **Upon Retreat** can buff allies. Rejoining once per fight **halves** carried stacks — front-load your best burst before returning. Scaling conditions: +2% damage per Courier Trunk — Rodion (max +40%).
playstyle_guide:
- **Courier Trunk** — below **15** you gain stacks faster; at **15+** skills spike and **Just… a Strategic Time Off!** can replace your Counter to begin the retreat sequence.
- Rejoining once per encounter **halves** your carried stacks — treat the first rotation as your main value window before returning.
- Skills check **15+ Rupture** — favour those coins when stacked.
- Skills grant **Haste** — chain them when you need higher Speed next turn.
- Reach scaling conditions before committing S3: +2% damage per Courier Trunk — Rodion (max +40%).

**S1 — Courier Trunk - Decay Knife** (BP 3, CP +4, x2): rolls — low 3, high 11 (Slightly Low).
- Scales Coin Power with Courier stacks — apply liberally before committing (cap +2).
- Gain 1 Courier Trunk — Rodion; - If this unit has less than 15 Courier Trunk — Rodion, gain 1 additional Courier Trunk — Rodion

**S2 — Courier Trunk - Gadget Reveal** (BP 4, CP +4, x3): rolls — low 4, high 16 (Average / High stacked).
- Peak output requires both conditions: Deal +2% damage for every Courier Trunk — Rodion on self (max 40%) | Coin Power +1 for every 10 Courier Trunk — Rodion or for every 6 Rupture on target (max 2).
- Up to **+40% damage** (+2% per **Courier Trunk — Rodion**) — stack the resource before committing.
- Gain 1 Courier Trunk — Rodion; - If this unit has less than 15 Courier Trunk — Rodion, gain 1 additional Courier Trunk — Rodion
- Gain 1 Haste next turn (once per turn)

**S3 — I Trust Ya, Polu!** (BP 5, CP +4, x3): rolls — low 5, high 17 (Average / High stacked).
- Peak output requires both conditions: Deal +4% damage for every Courier Trunk — Rodion (max 80%) | Coin Power +1 for every 10 Courier Trunk — Rodion on self or for every 6 Rupture on target (max 2).
- Inflict +3 Rupture Count (once per turn)
- Peak output requires both conditions: At 15+ Courier Trunk — Rodion, deal +15% damage | [Attack End] If target is Staggered or defeated, gain 1 Haste next turn (once per turn).

Combat passive — **Lemme go and I swear I'll make it in time!**: <For Chain Battles> When, after Retreating with 'Strategic R&R Mode', if this unit rejoins the battle, halve the Courier Trunk — Rodion v….

Combat passive — **Speedy Delivery**: Turn Start: At 6+ Speed, or if this unit has Haste, gain (Courier Trunk — Rodion)% of this unit's max HP as Shield (max 20%).
  - Upon Retreat, apply 1 Clash Power Up to 2 allies next turn (prioritizes Substituted units first, then in Deployment order).
  - Lasts for 1 additional turn for every 15 Courier Trunk — Rodion on self (2 more turns max).

Defense skill — **Counter: Courier Support & Control Sequence**: [Combat Start] At 15+ Courier Trunk — Rodion, activate 'Just… a Strategic Time Off!' instead (once per turn).
  - [Combat Start] If this Skill is to be activated, gain (Courier Trunk — Rodion)% of this unit's max HP as Shield (max 25%, once per turn).
  - [On Use] Gain 2 Courier Trunk — Rodion (once per turn).
  - At less than 15 Courier Trunk — Rodion, gain 1 additional Courier Trunk — Rodion.
